sentiment: We keep drawing blue blood from a creature older than memory, hoping something alive survives the compression.

stories.title: Compression is prediction
stories.summary: Information theory connects compression and prediction: the better a system understands what comes next, the more efficiently it can represent what's now.

stories.title: The lifesaving secret hidden inside a horseshoe crab's blue blood
stories.summary: Horseshoe crab blood is the source of LAL, an irreplaceable bacterial-detection agent used to ensure every injectable drug and medical implant is safe.

stories.title: llama.cpp
